_about: Inputs as the Gemini API sends them. The streamed answer and the 503 body are CAPTURED (captured/gemini-503-retry-then-stream.txt, read by capturedLines() / capturedEntry()); the entries below are from the documentation each cites. Values are illustrative; no expected value lives here.

stream_thoughts.source: streamGenerateContent with thinkingConfig.includeThoughts (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/thinking, 'Thought summaries', streaming): parts flagged thought: true; usageMetadata with thoughtsTokenCount and cachedContentTokenCount (https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content#UsageMetadata)

parts.text:
**Planning the answer**
The user asks for a greeting.

usage_only_chunk.source: spec 04 'Per-provider support' (google_gemini): usageMetadata 'can ride on a chunk with no candidates'; fields from https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content#UsageMetadata

error_429_daily.source: 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED body of the Gemini API (google.rpc error model, https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits and https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors): QuotaFailure + Help + RetryInfo

error.message: You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details.

links.description: Learn more about Gemini API quotas

error_429_minute.source: same shape as error_429_daily, with a per-minute quotaId

error.message: You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details.

error_400_key.source: 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT for a bad key (google.rpc error model with ErrorInfo, https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors)

error.message: API key not valid. Please pass a valid API key.
